name: Diana Siri Breaux
tagline: Top rated General Litigation attorney in Seattle, Washington
about: Diana Siri Breaux is an attorney who represents clients in the Seattle, Washington area. Diana Breaux is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Diana Breaux chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. She attended Fordham University School of Law and graduated in 2005. Diana Breaux passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2006.
She represents clients with General Litigation issues in Washington. She also represents clients with Intellectual Property Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Diana Breaux has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
315 Fifth Ave S Suite 1000 Seattle, WA 98104
